Applications must be submitted online on or before 08-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Ahmedabad to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Ahmedabad Associate Vice President – Executive Education Programme Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Associate Vice President – Executive Education Programme posts at IIM Ahmedabad is 08 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBA or equivalent degree from a reputed institute to be eligible for the Associate Vice President – Executive Education Programme position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 55 years. There is no age relaxation provided for any category.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Associate Vice President – Executive Education Programme post?
faq.answer: The salary offered is as per Pay Level 13 of the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC).

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Associate Vice President – Executive Education Programme?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Associate Vice President – Executive Education Programme post.

faq.question: Q7. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for a contractual job position at IIM Ahmedabad.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIM Ahmedabad located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad is located in Ahmedabad, Gujarat.

faq.question: Q9. What is the minimum experience required for the Associate Vice President role?
faq.answer: A minimum of 15 years of experience is required, with at least five years in a senior position, including experience in designing, developing, and marketing executive education programs.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website of IIM Ahmedabad on or before the last date of application.
